# Research Evidence Dossier for Daily Digest #080 (2026-10-13)

**Search Window Used**: 7 days (expanded from 24 hours to capture high-signal institution announcements and open source code/model releases published between October 8 and October 12, 2026).

## Candidate 1: Feminist Structure Signal

* **Proposed Section**: Feminist Structure Signal
* **Title (ZH/EN)**: Mimosa House 举办 Mira Schor 英国首个公立机构个展《WET/London》：以身体与文字重构女性主义绘画政治 / Mimosa House Presents Mira Schor's First UK Institutional Solo Exhibition 'WET/London'
* **Source URL**: `https://mimosahouse.co.uk/wet-london`
* **Publication / Event Date**: October 9 – December 5, 2026 (Opening reception: October 8, 2026)
* **Verified Facts**:
  * Mimosa House (London) presented *WET/London*, a solo exhibition by American artist and writer Mira Schor (b. 1950), curated by Daria Han.
  * This marks Schor’s first solo exhibition in a UK publicly funded gallery.
  * Schor studied in the CalArts Feminist Art Program under Judy Chicago and Miriam Schapiro in the early 1970s, and co-founded the influential feminist art journal *M/E/A/N/I/N/G* with Susan Bee in 1986.
  * The exhibition gathers historic and recent paintings, drawings, and works on paper from the 1970s to the present (including *Goodbye CalArts*, 1972; *Graves*, 1973; *Area of Denial I*, 1993; *The Work (Red Studio)*, 2021).
  * Features a newly commissioned site-specific painting executed directly on Mimosa House's six-meter fireplace wall, transforming a traditionally domestic site into a space for feminist public address and inscription.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Directly links feminist visual culture, painting as a political/discursive tool, body politics, and independent feminist publishing archives (*M/E/A/N/I/N/G*).
* **Duplication Assessment**: New (Mira Schor and Mimosa House have not appeared in recent issues).

## Candidate 2: Visual Culture Signal

* **Proposed Section**: Visual Culture Signal
* **Title (ZH/EN)**: 泰特现代美术馆开幕全球画意摄影大展《光与魔法》：以 200 余幅暗房原作重构跨国摄影史 / Tate Modern Presents 'Light and Magic: The Birth of Art Photography' Exploring Global Pictorialism
* **Source URL**: `https://www.tate.org.uk/whats-on/tate-modern/light-and-magic`
* **Publication / Event Date**: October 12, 2026 (Press release) / October 14, 2026 – February 21, 2027 (Exhibition dates)
* **Verified Facts**:
  * Tate Modern announced the opening of *Light and Magic: The Birth of Art Photography*, curated by Charmaine Toh and Genevieve Barton.
  * It is the first major museum exhibition to re-evaluate Pictorialism (画意摄影) as an international movement spanning from the 1880s to the 1960s, expanding beyond traditional Euro-American frameworks.
  * Brings together over 200 rare vintage prints by more than 80 artists from Seoul, Shanghai, Singapore, Sydney, New York, Cape Town, and Rio de Janeiro.
  * Highlights include East Asian pictorial photography pioneers such as Long Chin-San (郎静山), Fan Ho (何藩), and Luo Bonian (罗伯年), alongside Indian-born photographer Shapoor N. Bhedwar and British photographer Emma Barton.
  * Includes archival research into historical camera clubs and collective networks, including Shanghai’s Guangshe (光社) and the Photographic Society of Singapore, as well as an active darkroom inside the gallery space.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Directly aligns with photography history, media archaeology, darkroom chemical materiality, and East Asian image networks.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New (This exhibition and theme have not appeared in recent issues).

## Candidate 3: China / East Asia Signal

* **Proposed Section**: China / East Asia Signal
* **Title (ZH/EN)**: 梁慧圭最大规模美国委任展《Through》于 Dia Beacon 开幕：以“五行”与尹伊桑音乐贯穿上下双层建筑 / Haegue Yang's Largest US Commission 'Through' Opens at Dia Beacon
* **Source URL**: `https://www.diaart.org/exhibitions/haegue-yang-through`
* **Publication / Event Date**: October 10, 2026 – June 12, 2028 (Opened October 10, 2026)
* **Verified Facts**:
  * South Korean artist Haegue Yang (梁慧圭) opened her largest commission in the United States, *Through*, at Dia Beacon in New York State, curated by Jordan Carter and Min Sun Jeon.
  * It is the first time an artist has conceived a body of work connecting multiple galleries across both the ground floor and subterranean levels of Dia Beacon.
  * Yang maps architectural dualities (light/dark, subterranean/elevated) using the cardinal directions and color associations of traditional East Asian Five Phases theory (五行思想).
  * Central to the installation is Yang’s decade-long research into South Korean political exile composer Isang Yun (尹伊桑, 1917–1995), rescoring his 1968 string quartet *Images* into multi-sensory sculptural and kinetic form across the space.
* **Relevance to Muki**: East Asian contemporary art practice, transnational diaspora archives, cross-disciplinary rescoring, and media/sensory space research.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New (Haegue Yang and Dia Beacon have not appeared in recent issues).

## Candidate 4: AI Research / Creative Tech Signal

* **Proposed Section**: AI Research / Creative Tech Signal
* **Title (ZH/EN)**: 阿里开源 Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo 蒸馏扩散模型：8 步去噪实现高精图像生成与多参考图编辑 / Alibaba Releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo for 8-Step Fast Generation and Editing
* **Source URL**: `https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo`
* **Publication / Event Date**: October 9, 2026 (Model weights & diffusers PR released) / October 9–10, 2026 (ComfyUI repackaged weights published)
* **Verified Facts**:
  * Alibaba released *Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo*, an official distilled checkpoint of its 7B visual DiT generator and editing pipeline.
  * The Turbo checkpoint bakes in an 8-step denoising schedule with default CFG=1 (down from 40 steps in the base model), speeding up inference by 4–5x while maintaining image generation quality.
  * Supports text-to-image, multi-reference editing (up to 10 context images), RGBA transparency layer generation, subject extraction, and ControlNet integration.
  * Official Comfy-Org weights (`Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1`) enable day-0 local workflow execution inside ComfyUI with prefix KV cache reuse.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Substantive performance upgrade and workflow speedup for local AI-native image production, transparent asset creation, and multi-layer editing.
* **Duplication Assessment**: Follow-up (Follows up on the Qwen-Image-2.1 base model entry in the 2026-09-30 issue, highlighting the newly published 8-step Turbo distillation release).

## Candidate 5: Archive / Long Read / Opportunity

* **Proposed Section**: Archive / Long Read / Opportunity
* **Title (ZH/EN)**: 英国 Autograph 影像中心启动“Our Bodies that are Unruly”全球摄影征集：以身体为阵地探讨酷儿、离散与女性主义政治 / Autograph Launches 'Our Bodies that are Unruly' Open Call for Photography
* **Source URL**: `https://autograph.org.uk/open-calls-and-opportunites`
* **Publication / Event Date**: October 2026 (Open Call published) / Deadline: December 7, 2026 at 10:00 AM GMT
* **Verified Facts**:
  * Autograph (London) issued an open call for photographic submissions titled *Our Bodies that are Unruly*.
  * The call invites lens-based artists and image-makers to submit works exploring how the body interacts with surroundings to challenge power structures, act as a site of resistance, and assert self-definition.
  * The initiative is directly inspired by Autograph’s current exhibition season, focusing on queer, indigenous, diasporic, and feminist bodily practices.
  * Selected submissions will be showcased across Autograph's digital platforms and public programs.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Direct, actionable funding/exhibition opportunity for photography researchers and artists focusing on care, body politics, diaspora, and feminist resistance.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New (Autograph's open call has not appeared in recent issues).
